description: Source code implementing the Link Layer Control Protocol (LLCP) for Bluetooth Low Energy, including FSMs for local and remote procedures, handling of various LL control PDUs, and procedures for connection management, feature exchange, version exchange, and CTE requests.

methods.name: lp_comm_ntf
methods.description: Handles notification encoding and scheduling for various LL procedures based on context.

methods.name: lp_comm_terminate_invalid_pdu
methods.description: Terminates connection upon receiving invalid PDU.

methods.name: lp_comm_complete
methods.description: Completes a local procedure, handling success or invalid responses.

methods.name: lp_comm_tx
methods.description: Encodes and enqueues a control PDU for transmission.

methods.name: lp_comm_tx_proxy
methods.description: Attempts to send a control PDU, handling flow control and state transitions.

methods.name: lp_comm_send_req
methods.description: Sends a request PDU based on the current procedure.

methods.name: lp_comm_st_idle
methods.description: State handler for idle state, initiates procedures.

methods.name: lp_comm_st_wait_tx
methods.description: State handler for waiting to transmit.

methods.name: lp_comm_st_wait_tx_ack
methods.description: State handler for waiting for transmission acknowledgment.

methods.name: lp_comm_rx_decode
methods.description: Decodes received PDU and updates procedure context.

methods.name: lp_comm_st_wait_rx
methods.description: State handler for waiting for received PDU.

methods.name: lp_comm_st_wait_ntf_avail
methods.description: State handler for waiting for notification buffer availability.

methods.name: lp_comm_execute_fsm
methods.description: Executes the FSM based on current state and event.

methods.name: llcp_lp_comm_tx_ack
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment of transmitted control PDU.

methods.name: llcp_lp_comm_rx
methods.description: Handles reception of control PDU.

methods.name: llcp_lp_comm_init_proc
methods.description: Initializes local procedure context.

methods.name: llcp_lp_comm_run
methods.description: Runs a local procedure FSM.

methods.name: rp_comm_terminate
methods.description: Terminates remote procedure and connection.

methods.name: rp_comm_stop_cis
methods.description: Stops a CIS in ISO connections.

methods.name: rp_comm_rx_decode
methods.description: Decodes received PDU for remote procedures.

methods.name: rp_comm_tx
methods.description: Encodes and transmits a control PDU for remote procedures.

methods.name: rp_comm_st_idle
methods.description: Remote procedure idle state handler.

methods.name: rp_comm_ntf
methods.description: Handles notification encoding and scheduling for remote procedures.

methods.name: rp_comm_tx_proxy
methods.description: Attempts to send a remote procedure PDU, handling flow control.

methods.name: rp_comm_send_rsp
methods.description: Sends a response PDU for remote procedures.

methods.name: rp_comm_st_wait_rx
methods.description: Remote procedure wait for reception state handler.

methods.name: rp_comm_st_postpone_terminate
methods.description: Postpones termination until next event.

methods.name: rp_comm_st_wait_tx
methods.description: Remote procedure wait to transmit.

methods.name: rp_comm_st_wait_tx_ack
methods.description: Remote procedure wait for transmit acknowledgment.

methods.name: rp_comm_execute_fsm
methods.description: Executes the remote procedure FSM based on current state and event.
